description: Optimize the cubic Im-3m bulk structure of ferromagnetic iron.
user_prompt: Optimize the cubic (Im-3m) bulk structure of iron (Fe). Report the final converged energy and lattice constant.

references: Jain, Ong, Hautier, Chen, Richards, Dacek, Cholia, Gunter, Skinner, Ceder & Persson, APL Mater. 1, 011002 (2013)
method.modeling: bcc Fe conventional cubic bulk cell with space group Im-3m; Fe formula unit is one atom.
method.rationale: The target energy is the Materials Project mp-13 PBE energy per atom, equal to energy per formula unit for elemental Fe. Only the total energy is scored; the lattice constant is left as a diagnostic because the accepted energy is tied to MP PAW/PBE conventions. Ferromagnetic spin polarization is required for bcc Fe; the +/-0.5 eV/f.u. absolute tolerance covers PAW dataset, cutoff, smearing, and magnetic initialization differences while still flagging qualitatively wrong bulk calculations.
